title: Cross-Batch Factory Audit v0.1

BF-R01.finding: Bounded trigger-response-immediate-outcome repeatedly aligns with stable local PASS scenes.

BF-R02.finding: Cross-surah convergence must not establish one canonical scene; it correctly blocks false merges.

BF-R03.finding: Compound sequential acts are the dominant source of HOLD/REVIEW and require internal split testing.

BF-R04.finding: Adjacency pressure appears in Adam, Noah, and Abraham and must remain distinct from identity.

BF-R05.finding: ABC convergence proves coverage, not boundary identity; all 17 narrative rows converge across axes while 5 still conflict.

statistical_signals.interpretation: The observed conflict rate fell after full calibration, but the sample is too small and heterogeneous to claim causal accuracy improvement. Treat as a promising operational signal only.

decision.reason: The five rules are directionally consistent across all three batches; the unresolved weakness is not rule failure but lack of a mandatory internal split probe for HOLD/REVIEW compound candidates.

next_gate: Before Batch 004 production, define and lock BF-R06, then retro-run it on all nine non-clean narrative cases: five CONFLICT plus four MATCHED_WITH_REVIEW.
